role: Dirichlet–Pell pigeonhole: two congruent near-certificates in M₂(ℤ) divide to an exact certificate

Pell's quotient trick lands in a group (units). ES certificates are not closed under quotients: the congruence a ≡ d ≡ −1 mod c ties the modulus to the entry c, and positivity fails. role: descent by Galois parity: potential ES over a real quadratic K
missing_theorem: For some real quadratic K and every p, the number of totally positive O_K-solutions of 4/p = Σ1/x_i in a Gal(K/ℚ)-stable finite set is odd. Non-rational solutions pair under conjugation, so the K-count ≡ the ℚ-count (mod 2). The missing theorem is therefore the same as 'the ℚ-count in that set is odd', which is ES itself in parity form. Any count-parity theorem must also see the quadratic character, since the Type I/II count is 0 at odd squares (M5 row).
